tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the curated fitness knowledge base for evidence about exercises, muscle groups, workout programming, training volume, progression, and recovery.

query.description: The fitness topic or question to search for.

max_results.description: Maximum number of relevant documents to retrieve.

tools.name: find_nearby_places
tools.description: Find nearby gyms, sports equipment stores, or supplement stores based on the user's location. Return available place details and distances.

location.description: The user's location, address, or postcode.

place_type.description: The type of place to search for.

search_term.description: Optional name or specific item to search for.

tools.name: schedule_workout_plan
tools.description: Analyse the user's timetable and fitness plan, propose suitable training days and times, and save the approved sessions to the user's workout schedule. Workout plan generation is handled by a separate tool.

plan_metadata.description: Information about the user's existing fitness goal and workout plan.

session_duration_minutes.description: Maximum preferred duration of each workout session.

availability.description: Days when the user is available to train. If omitted, use the user's timetable.
